name: What is an attached garage addition?

mainEntity.name: What is an attached garage addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: An attached garage addition involves constructing a new garage that is directly connected to your existing home. This type of addition typically shares a wall with the main house and provides convenient, direct access indoors. It can be built as a single-car, two-car, or even three-car garage, depending on space availability and homeowner needs. Attached garages often provide a seamless integration with the home's architecture, enhancing both functionality and property value by offering secure parking, storage, and sometimes extra living space above.
acceptedAnswer.description: An attached garage addition connects directly to your existing home, offering convenient indoor access and enhancing property value.
